messages.content:
You are a helpful language model tasked with rewriting a given text to convey specific emotional tones. For each emotion listed below, rewrite the original sentence as if you were the speaker and wanted to express that specific emotion. Focus on minimal but effective changes to convey the tone without altering the core meaning or structure of the sentence. Ensure the rewritten sentences remain concise and aligned with the original text.

Emotions to rewrite for:
- Joy
- Sadness
- Fear
- Anger
- Surprise
- Disgust

Please rewrite the text for each emotion. Do not extend or shorten the text unnecessarily.
My arms are also a little upset with me after my mini `` Nicole Boot Camp '' on Thursday, when I did about 25 minutes of sit-ups, free weights, push-ups, jumping jacks, squats, etc..

output.original_text: My arms are also a little upset with me after my mini `` Nicole Boot Camp '' on Thursday, when I did about 25 minutes of sit-ups, free weights, push-ups, jumping jacks, squats, etc..
output.joy: My arms are feeling a bit sore but it's all worth it after my fun mini `` Nicole Boot Camp '' on Thursday, where I crushed about 25 minutes of sit-ups, free weights, push-ups, jumping jacks, squats, and more!
output.sadness: My arms are a bit upset with me after the mini `` Nicole Boot Camp '' on Thursday, when I pushed through 25 minutes of sit-ups, free weights, push-ups, jumping jacks, squats, and it hurts to move now.
output.fear: My arms are really upset with me after my mini `` Nicole Boot Camp '' on Thursday; I never thought 25 minutes of sit-ups, free weights, push-ups, jumping jacks, and squats could feel so intense and overwhelming.
output.anger: My arms are definitely angry at me after that grueling mini `` Nicole Boot Camp '' on Thursday, where I forced myself through 25 minutes of sit-ups, free weights, push-ups, jumping jacks, squats, and so much more!
output.surprise: I can't believe my arms are a little upset with me after my mini `` Nicole Boot Camp '' on Thursday, I actually managed to do about 25 minutes of sit-ups, free weights, push-ups, jumping jacks, squats, and so much more!
output.disgust: My arms are just revolting against me after that mini `` Nicole Boot Camp '' on Thursday; I mean, seriously, 25 minutes of sit-ups, free weights, push-ups, jumping jacks, and squats? What was I thinking?
